scripts.test: npm run test:kernel && npm run test:server && npm run test:web && npm run test:prototype
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @torsor/kernel && npm run typecheck --workspace @torsor/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @torsor/web && npm exec --prefix prototype -- tsc --noEmit -p prototype/tsconfig.app.json
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @torsor/kernel && npm run build --workspace @torsor/server && npm run build --workspace @torsor/web && npm --prefix prototype run build
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
